archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / ELECTRIC SECURITY VAULT

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: DO NOT use Inter for main headings; use Unbounded or Clash Display font.
All overlines and security badges must use JetBrains Mono in uppercase with tracking-[0.2em].
Maximum heading text size is text-6xl (3.75rem).

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Relative border glow with Cyan/Violet moving ambient highlight for high-security panels
visual_enhancers.shadows: shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(6,182,212,0.15)] for cyber accent elements, layered ambient drop shadows
visual_enhancers.grid_borders: Subtle 1px cell dividers with border-white/5 for tactical command center look
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (2% opacity) on deep canvas to eliminate flat gradients

layout_and_grid.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing (p-6, p-8, p-12, gap-6, gap-8) to prevent visual density overload.
layout_and_grid.container_padding: Containers with borders MUST have at least p-6 internal padding.

bento_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Security Dashboard

crypto_pass_login_flow.behavior: Only ask for 'Crypto Passphrase / Pass' if the user's security profile has Crypto Pass ENABLED.
crypto_pass_login_flow.requirement: Do NOT prompt Crypto Pass for non-crypto enabled profiles. When disabled, standard auth occurs seamlessly.
crypto_pass_login_flow.ui: Conditional step in login modal/page with clear visual indicator of required auth tier.

hardcore_mode.behavior: Hardcore type is fixed & fully functional. Zero bugs, strict input validation, real-time lock out timers on consecutive failures.
hardcore_mode.ui: Tactical red warning indicators, warning dialog with explicit acknowledgement, instant cryptographic response.

advance_mode_passphrase_prompts.behavior: Layered passphrase validation before decrypting high-security vault items or modifying critical settings.
advance_mode_passphrase_prompts.ui: Interactive passphrase input with strength meter, Argon2 hash preview simulation, and lock state.

vault_security_dashboard.behavior: Complete vault overview with real-time threat monitor, active sessions, key status, and granular security controls.
vault_security_dashboard.ui: Bento-style layout with live security score, audit logs, and toggle controls.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or crisp rectangular buttons with cyan/violet primary focus rings. Includes hover lift (-translate-y-0.5) and glow effect. Explicit hover text colors always set.
components.inputs: Dark input field bg-slate-900/90 border-slate-700/60 focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 text-slate-100 font-mono text-sm px-4 py-3 rounded-lg
components.cards: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-xl p-6 hover:border-slate-700 transition-all duration-200
components.modals_and_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog/Sheet with backdrop-blur-2xl bg-slate-950/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6
components.toasts: Sonner toast notifications (located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx) with high contrast background and custom action buttons.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer Motion opacity fade + slight vertical slide (y: 10 to y: 0)

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Crypto Pass login step is conditionally rendered based on user settings (if user has enabled Crypto pass, prompt for Crypto pass; otherwise do not prompt).
Fix Hardcore Mode type check so it works flawlessly across all login/vault actions without errors or broken validations.
Remove 'View Crypto Pass' button as requested to prevent plain-text exposure or unauthorized decryption inspection.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, toggles, tabs, and informational displays include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='crypto-pass-input').
Maintain high APCA text contrast with explicit hover text colors (never rely on default hover inheritance).
Use Sonner for toasts and Shadcn UI components for dropdowns, dialogs, tabs, and switches.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
